subject.title: [Bug]: `/acp close` does not clear acpx FileSessionStore — stale `acp_session_id` causes unwanted `session/resume` instead of `session/new`

question: Should a focused v2026.7.1/current-main same-process and restart reproduction be required before sponsoring the cross-boundary ACPX close repair?
rationale: The source path and documented contract strongly support the report, but the exact current-release interaction between manager handle eviction, the reset-aware store, and ACPX closed-record semantics has not been observed live.

options.title: Require current live proof
options.body: Reproduce close followed by another turn before and after gateway restart, then implement the bounded lifecycle repair against the confirmed surviving layer.

options.title: Accept source proof now
options.body: Treat the existing source reproduction as sufficient and immediately sponsor a coordinated manager-plus-ACPX regression fix.

recommendation.title: Require current live proof
recommendation.body: Reproduce close followed by another turn before and after gateway restart, then implement the bounded lifecycle repair against the confirmed surviving layer.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already subscribed to this issue and are the best available owner for deciding whether the current evidence is sufficient to start cross-boundary work.
